name: aether
description: Aether — unified web app (React client + Express API)

scripts.dev: node scripts/free-dev-port.mjs && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev -w server" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5001/health && npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.start:prod: npm run build && npm run start:prod -w server
